caption: The drawing depicts a mechanical device constructed primarily from wood, featuring a rectangular box with a hinged lid that is depicted partially open. Inside the box, there is a cylindrical drum with evenly spaced protrusions, likely made of a metallic material with a dull gray color, and gears or teeth that interlock with another set of components mounted on the underside of the lid. Attached to the right side of the box is a hand crank with a wooden handle, which is shaded brown. Additionally, a funnel-shaped component made of metal, with a dark, weathered appearance, is mounted at the top right of the box. The wood of the box is rendered in light to medium brown hues with visible grain, and the metal parts display shades of gray and dark brown. The background is plain, off-white, and unadorned. The artist’s signature, “Geoffrey Holt,” appears in the lower right corner.
title: Meat Grinder
